scope: Measured live samples from completed, recent and upcoming EPL fixtures; this artifact records qualification evidence only and does not select source policy.

chronology.evidence: summary metadata exposed lastUpdatedAt, firstPlayWallClock, lastPlayWallClock and post state

ESPN.identity: stable event IDs and team/player IDs in JSON

Sofascore.limitation: installed SoccerData wrapper exposed schedule and league table; lineups, events, shots and match player stats were not measured through this boundary

semantics.shots: shot event rows include shot_id, location, minute, body_part, situation and result
semantics.chronology: match date and season identifiers present; no source availability timestamp measured

fixtures.identity: schedule date/time plus normalized home/away names

odds.collection_note: source notes state weekend odds are collected Friday afternoons and midweek odds Tuesday afternoons
odds.semantic_status: pre-closing and closing snapshots/aggregates, not a time series

chronology.explanation: the schedule hash is not honored by the unfragmented match route; page data resolves to a current-season event while the visible page remains the historical fixture

FotMob.limitation: do not use match-detail route identity or chronology for fallback until a direct endpoint keyed by the schedule fixture ID is proven

fixture_identity.reason: ESPN, Sofascore, Understat and FotMob expose stable IDs; Football-Data requires schedule/name matching

kickoff_chronology.reason: sources expose kickoff values but correction and source-availability timestamps are not uniform

lineups_events_stats.reason: ESPN is measured; Sofascore match-level fields were not measured and Understat is not a lineup/event authority

xg.reason: Understat xG is explicit but provider models and shot inclusion semantics differ from ESPN/FotMob

odds.reason: Football-Data opening/closing values lack per-quote timestamps; a point-in-time comparison needs timestamped observations
